svg.title: Inside one Novu Box
svg.desc: Architecture of one Novu Box container on Cloudflare: Caddy takes every request the Box Durable Object forwards and routes it by path to the dashboard, the api, the socket worker, Mailpit and s3; the api queues jobs in sqs for the worker, which sends email to Mailpit and SMS, push and chat to the sink; the api and worker call the bridge app, and Slack traffic goes through the Router Durable Object.
